crime: Every evening in the lounge, a girl opened her mending tin and mended {WITCH_NAME}'s clothes, while {WITCH_NAME} sat beside her and passed her the thread, one color after another. One evening her friend held out a shirt with a torn cuff and put the needle in her hand. "Sew this one yourself. You should learn to do it without me." {WITCH_NAME}'s face stayed calm, while the spool of thread in her lap shook for her.
Her mother had once taught her to sew on her own coat button. "So you can do it without me." By morning, her mother was gone.

At half past seven, her friend went down to the cells to lay the mending out on the bunks. {WITCH_NAME} followed her down, took the tape measure her friend always wore around her neck while sewing, and pulled it tight around her throat until her friend went still. Before eight, she drew the blanket over the body and poured her own shaking and tears into it. When she let go, the blanket kept shuddering.

From eight until lockup at ten, she sat composed among the others in the lounge. At lockup, as the prisoners filed down the cell corridor to their cells, they saw through the bars a blanket shuddering like a girl crying underneath it. Her roommate let her cry and went to sleep.
With {WITCH_NAME} in plain sight in the lounge all evening, the prisoners concluded in the trial court that the girl had died after lockup, locked in with no one but her roommate.

Then a prisoner washing the dead girl's face in the cell found no salt on her lashes, though the blanket that had covered them was stiff with it. Back in the trial court, the prisoners understood whose tears those were, and that the blanket had been crying over a girl already dead before the doors were locked.
fields.epitaph: The only time anyone saw her cry, they took it for her friend.
fields.epithet: The Calm Face That Hears Goodbye Coming
execution: She is bound upright to a giant sewing needle, beneath a spool of thread hanging from above. The needle begins to turn, slowly, drawing the thread around her from her ankles upward. She keeps her face calm. The needle shivers with her trembling instead. The thread climbs over her mouth and nose, turn after turn across her calm face. At last the needle stops shivering, and the spool winds on over a still shape.

magic.name: Brave Face
magic.text: She can shift every outward sign of her feelings onto an object she touches.
